test_test_net: test the python module to run video classification inference with Caffe2 on a test dataset
test_test_net_one_section: test the python module to run multi-clip video inference in memory-efficient sections
test_evaluate_result: test the python module to evaluate video classification results against ground truth labels
test_read_groundtruth: test the python module to read ground truth labels from a text file
test_main: test the python module to parse CLI arguments and launch video classification testing
